sentences.en: The journalist was too upset to distinguish vice from virtue.
sentences.zh: 这位记者心烦意乱，无法分辨是非。

sentences.en: Don't be upset by a sudden change in the weather.
sentences.zh: 别因为天气突变而心烦意乱。

sentences.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
sentences.zh: 合并后，办公室里一片混乱。
